I like a range of scents or items to keep my beard in good shape, but I have a far more difficult time finding things that work and are okay on my skin. I have only used these items once, but that’s all it takes to know. I come away happy - they all worked and NO reaction. I used the shampoo and conditioner in the shower today and they not only had a nice, light scent, but I was bale to let it sit on the beard for a few minutes each, having no issues with skin and liking the smell. The beard felt soft following and I liked how they worked overall. Next, the oil. I believe it is claimed to be used for “beard growth,” and maybe it’ll help with that. My beard is decent, but I do have spots that could use thickening, so again, I keep an eye open for options. However, there is no way to know if it’ll work for that for a few weeks if not months. So until then, it again did fine on my skin - not a single ounce of negative reaction. The sect is light, so it’s nice to smell, but one (my wife) has to get up close to smell it. I do like it that way, so it doesn’t bug my sinuses or overwhelm. In the end I’m very happy so far with this Beard Growth Kit, 10 In 1 Beard Kit For Men with Beard Oil, Beard Balm, Beard Conditioner set and happy I grabbed it. I’ll use it and if all stays well, would consider getting it again.

title: So far this is working well for my sensitive skin; will see how it goes in the long run
text:
First off, I have extremely sensitive skin overall, but especially on my face. To that end, I must be very carefully about what I put on. I do tend towards lighter or no scents, but have found some that work alright for me. But with or without scent, I can still have issues. In the end, it’s how my skin handles anything that is the bottom line for me. In this case, this Provence Beauty Beard Oil - All Natural Fragrance Free Olive, Sunflower & Jojoba Oils works well for me and so far, I’m very pleased.

I use a derma roller a couple times a week to help with hair in my beard and front of my head. At this point I then add a beard oil to these locations to help stimulate growth. Without doing major testing with all the elements, like a control group (area) of my head, it’s hard to say what works and what doesn’t. I feel like the derma roller has a large part in how well growth or at least slowing of loss goes. But, I have also come to believe some of these oils available do play a supportive role. To that point, I won’t be able to speak about this Provence Beauty Beard Oil - All Natural Fragrance Free Olive, Sunflower & Jojoba Oils for awhile. I have only just begun to use it - as a replacement for another oil.

But I do like that 1. it’s not too oily on my hair or skin, 2. has little to no real scent, 3. feels fine and is not a problem on my skin, and 4. that it washes off my hands easily post application. Right now I like it as an oil providing at least some softening to my beard. Will it aide growth? We shall see...

title: I really wanted to like this and I do, except, my sensitivities can’t take it
text:
I will fully admit up front, I have a very bad sensitivity to scents. In my years of life I’ve only found maybe half a dozen I can put up with. I usually avoid them - but because I enjoy them - I do try to find ways to use it. Because of these sensitivities I try not to “blame” the product, unless it burns - then I have to question what all is in there. In this case, I decided to try Atlas Semi Matte Texture Putty 2.4 Ounce is a Medium Shine because of other reviews - I was hoping... but sadly, nope, I can’t do it. So I’m giving it 4 stars 1. because I do like the smell, but 2. it lasts far too long, smelled like it got stronger than lighter, and in the end, was too much for me. I got the Atlas Semi Matte Texture Putty 2.4 Ounce is a Medium Shine and both my wife and I liked the smell, but immediately worried it would be too much based on first sniffs. I put it on, and it worked great. It’s easy to put on - only a small amount covered my hair easily - and smelled nice. It was easy to work with my hair and it looked great. But as time went on, this Atlas Semi Matte Texture Putty started to smell more and more and more. The smell did not dissipate, but grew. And my head started to really hurt.
In the end, I do like this Atlas Semi Matte Texture Putty 2.4 Ounce is a Medium Shine for how it works and how it looks. But for sensitive guys, you need to be aware, this putty has a strong scent - in my case at least, too strong. I won’t be able to keep using it.

title: It’s a decent idea, it worked, but not with the included suction cups
text:
I drive my wife nuts when I trim my beard in the bathroom - I try to catch all the clippings, but without something like this, it does not work well. I thought I”d give this a try - it seems like a great idea, but...

1. It arrived with 1 plastic bib, 2 suction cups with hooks, and 1 shaving cream brush.
2. The plastic bib feels okay - it’s a thin plastic, but it should last for a decent amount of time. It is not as nice as most of the kinds I’ve experienced or we own for haircutting
3. Its stitching is okay - I think it’ll last decently
4. There are two loops on the ends you will attach to the suction cups.
5. The suction cups - are worthless. This is why it gets the 4 stars - I would have given it 3 stars if we didn’t have our own suction cups to use instead of theirs. One of the two that came with it stuck for 5 - 10 seconds before it stopped working altogether. The other suction cup doesn’t even look right - it looks like it never worked and was not made properly.
6. We have suction cups (bought on Amazon) we were able to use - I looped that part of the bib onto them, which worked, but not designed for this, they would fall off. I’ll end up taping them to it - at least that way I’ll be able to use it.
7. It fit me fine. It felt fine - just like a haircut cape. The white looks weird - I’m used to the far more common black - but at the same time I think it’ll show the beard hair really well.
8. I did notice that as I go in closer to the mirror to see what I’m doing it folds over in front of me and isn’t as trapped out - be aware of this because it’s easy to start missing the catch in the bib.

Overall it’s a decent thing to have and it’ll make my wife happy not getting the beard clippings all over the place. This could be a little nicer - a little thicker plastic, much better suction cups - which would easily earn it a 5 star rating. But for what it is, I’m happy to have it. If it lasts, it’ll be great.

title: Not Bad
text: This is the second set of different colors of this brand I have purchased and they are decent nail polish. The colors go on strong and go good with nail art. There is a bit of a funky odor but it's nail polish so you would expect an odor. It did not take long to dry and the colors are great.

title: Beautiful
text: This Kissio 9 eye-shadows pack is really nice! But the fun part is watching the shadow holder spin in circles in your palm. Once you open it, the spinning stops. So fun! There's 9 gorgeeeeeeeous sparkly colors to wear. I'll probably wear the majority of them over time. They're really nice and super easy to apply! Now that I'm retired, I don't wear makeup everyday so this pack will last me a long time. The shadows look nice and stay on for quite awhile before melting in the 90+ degree weather that were experiencing which created a drought here. But these eye shadows will definitely brighten up your day! I like them!

title: A Very Versatile Mist Spray Bottle
text: These Scoot just spray bottles are fabulous for many uses. Most people use them for spraying beauty products, plants, hair spray, etc. However, I ordered them for my artwork to spray watercolor paint, inks, and acrylics. What I love about them is the fine mist and that you can see what product it contains. Also, once filled, you can turn the lock so there's no leaking. A very versatile plastic water spray bottle!

title: LOVE this perfume!
text: This Dance Midnight perfume by Shakira is really luscious and sexy! It has a strong floral and musk scent which is a heavier scent. It's very mysterious and breath takingly good. I love it! Even the bottle is sexy. It's a heavier scent that I usually love to wear during fall and winter. In spring and summer I will wear a lighter floral scent. I've worn this perfume 3 times now and get compliments each time. Usually from my husband too. I love this perfume!

title: Not very sparkly
text: The rhinestones in these "flowers" don't catch the light very well, so only one really looked sparkly in the light. Each clip has a bottom, 3.75" long clip (with about 3" of that for holding hair) with three 1" long clips (with 0.75" of that for holding hair) attached to it's top. The springs are strong, so they'll hold hair well. However, they're so strong that I have difficultly working them on my own hair. The "flowers" are also felt or some kind of stiff cloth glued to the plastic clip, so the "flowers" may come off with use.

title: Works to dry drippy hair faster after a shower
text: The package contained 3 microfiber Towel Wrap Turbans: one pink, one lavender, and one striped (orange, pink, blue, white). They are 26" in length. After a shower, I've wanted to wrap my long hair up in a towel for a while because otherwise it drips down my back as it dries. But I've never mastered getting a towel to stay in place. This product does help: place the large "hood" section in place on your head, tuck your hair into the tail then twist the tail one or two times, and secure the elastic loop over the button. It stays in place okay as long as you don't try to pull a shirt on over it (or similar activity). I put it on for about 20 minutes after my shower, and the Wrap is pretty wet when I take it off. My hair's still damp, but it dries much faster after that and doesn't drip down my back. So it works.

title: A Winner!
text:
If you're looking for wooden paddle brush for long, fine hair, then this one may be just what you need.

This brush is well constructed. It's made entirely of bamboo (the handle, body & bristles). However, the bristles are smooth. This results in a very sturdy brush that can easily work through tough tangles, but without causing unnecessary breakage.

And the price is right (under $8.00 with Prime at the time of this review).

If there's any downside then it would probably not the best brush to use on wet hair with a blow dryer because it's not designed for air flow.

However, if you're looking for a good, sturdy paddle brush to use on dry hair, then this is the one for you.

title: Not Really Sure Who This Brush Is For
text:
While this is a nice looking & seemingly well designed brush, I'm not really sure who it's best suited for.

My wife has been in search of a brush for fine hair. And while this brush is described to work on fine hair, it barely even brushed through the surface of her hair.

The bristles are so soft that it can't really grip. So just kind of glides over.

It may be useful more as a beard brush, but unfortunately, that's not what it's being sold as.

Giving it 2 stars for being a well made brush (wood handle is very nice), but just not very useful for its intended purpose, brushing!

title: Dependable Mary Kay.. at a good price
text: Dependable product from Mary Kay. I was tempted to save money for a cheaper product, but after 20 yrs and many compliments, I will stay with this product.

title: Well made and versatile
text: If you want to take a simple outfit to the next level, this is a quick and easy way to do it. They can be pinned to a jacket or blouse, and there is also a thick elastic band so that they can be added to a ponytail. They also look nice on some purses. They are stiff so they can handle storing several in one container. Some of the petals are made of a sheer fabric and others are opaque, which adds interest to the look. I have many of these in different colors, and I enjoy wearing them often.

title: Adds a little extra to any outfit.
text:
These flowers feel stiff and so they aren’t easily crushed and bent out of shape. They have a pin for wearing on clothing, and a thick, sturdy covered elastic for wearing with a ponytail.
I have several colors that help me add just the right amount of interest to several types of outfits. I’ve received many compliments while wearing them.

title: Not the best around
text: Not as expected

title: I have brunerr hair (with gray n it) but my eyebrows are a different thing
text: I'm just missing, thick eyebrows - I do have hair, but you an see through them...not enough hair. This kit helps me feel as if younger than my 65 years! Pick an eyebrow "style," use the frame and included pencil and I have eyebrows again!

title: If you have patches of coarse hair now that you are older...
text: My grandmother had issues with patches of dark, coarse hair on her face/chin area as she got older and apparently I have genetically inherited that problem. Therein lies the problem with using this appliance. I must shave before using this thing and then I get to be "pinched" over and over on that sensitive skin where I just shaved...I mean, if you find something hurting you, do you go back to it willingly? No...at least when I let the stubble get long enough and then wax, the pain from yanking that wax off is much faster and less painful that this light-pulsing machine. So, that said, it's just not the way to get rid of hair for me. If I had just a few hairs in one spot, maybe, but not the way the hair grows on my face/chin area.

title: Oh the uses for glycerin
text: This bottle I bought to put a scant teaspoon into my home made ice cream to keep it from forming ice crystals after storing in the freezer. I just bought a Cuisinart Ice Cream Machine and followed a simple recipe for chocolate ice cream, but I wanted to make sure that it would not become hard and full of ice crystals once I stored it in the freezer, so I did some research online and glycerin is one of several ways to keep ice cream creamy. It only takes a teaspoon in the recipe and the other thing about glycerin is that it is sweet, so it blends in well with an ice cream recipe. My ice cream turned out great and it is smooth and creamy after being in the freezer. Now, this is not my first use of glycerin as I have used a small amount in water to spray in my hair. Especially on really humid days when my naturally curly hair turns into a frizz-ball, spraying my hair with a 10 parts water, 1 part glycerin (or even less glycerin, depending) keeps my hair from frizzing out so bad. For me, in ice cream or in my hair, glycerin works great!

title: I got this bag for foot issues
text: I do suffer from some foot issues and use heat/shiatsu massage on my feet for circulation issues, but these salts are for relieving pain when dissolved in very warm water in my foot bath/massager. Okay, news-flash, I am a senior and not as active as I used to be but I am also very aware of keeping good circulation in my feet and making them feel as good as possible - arthritis in several joints means if I can lessen pain anywhere, I'll do that and my feet are important. I can truly say that these magnesium salts really do make my feet feel so much better when dissolved in the foot bath water. Because of my knees, I don't take baths any longer, but if I could easily sit down and get back up in the bath tub, I'd definitely try these salts in a nice long soak in the tub - I can imagine my whole body feeling as good as my feet afterwards! Considering the amount I use in my footbath, this is not a bad price at all either. When I use up this bag, I will be buying it again.

title: Just what I needed for my old furgirl
text: I have a rescued teacup poodle that is a frightened little diva when I try to groom her. I don't think the people who took care of her were nice or gentle with her in any way. Poor little thing is only 4.5 pounds and she's fairly old and toothless so it's not like she'd turn and bite anyone trying to keep her looking like the pretty little girl she is. I got this brush for her fine, curly hair. She is a sweet little girl, but will "bleat" if she thinks you intend to hurt her and the first time I put a brush to her, she was shivering like I was going to do something bad to her. I talked to her and took my time and by the time I was done, she was relaxed and let me work on her a little at a time. My other furgirl is an older, rescued papillion and because her fur is straight with no undercoat, this brush works great on her. She doesn't mind the brush at all and I think she likes how it lightly "scratches" her skin at the same time. Great brush for my two old girls!

title: My first time using a detangling brush
text: I have curly hair - very, very fine, but curly hair. Because my hair is so fine, I cannot use traditional combs or brushes when my hair is either wet or dry. I mean, all I have to do is one "flip" or have the wind move my hair once and the knots are there. For many years, after shampooing my hair, I used a very wide pick to comb through my hair. Even with a pick I have to go slowly since I will find at least one knot in my hair. Anyway, this is my first time using a detangling brush and it's not a bad deal. I still have to go slow, but I like how it goes through my hair more fully than the pick. Definitely worth a try if you have curly hair!

title: What a great set for my grandchildren
text: I remember my own children when they were small and how difficult it can be to ensure they all brushed their teeth at least twice a day - and spent a reasonable amount of time doing it. I don't try to interfere with how my son raises his children, but I gave this to him so his kids, my grandkids, could have the potential for better hygiene than my kids had. I have a similar one that I use myself and think this irrigator is a great way to ensure that they get good reports when visiting the dentist. Great price for this small, portable unit that comes with its own travel bag.

title: I had originally thought I might give this as a gift
text: But I had to open it and spray some on my hand...and that was it. I love the deep, spicy-sweet scent of this perfume. It was a few hours before bed when I sprayed this and when I went to bed, I had my arm up near my nose - oh, it smelled so good and helped me relax and fall asleep! Okay, so maybe that's not what you think of when looking for a great new perfume to wear, but it's not that it made me sleepy - it's just that it smelled so good I relaxed quickly and that allowed me to fall asleep. This would have been a great gift for one of my daughters in law, but no...I can't give it away! If you like that deep, spicy-sweet scent of certain perfumes, try this one. So worth it!

title: I have tried the drills that have batteries in the body of the drill
text: And while they don't seem to be bad, they just don't have the power that this one does. I'm thinking it has to do with the size/strength of the battery in the drill's attached power supply. While I do use this for my fingernails, I am using it more for my toenails and feet. Toenails are thick and tough and I have trouble cutting them well even with good toenail clippers so being able to file them a little at a time is much easier. Also, I have some very hard, thick skin on my feet and "grinding" that skin down is much easier that using a foot file. This is a wonderful nail drill that's not just for nails - sturdy like a workhorse, it will make short work of messy nails or hard, callused skin.

title: I took a chance, but again, I was wrong
text: See, I have naturally curly hair. The issue is when the weather is very dry over a few days' time, my hair goes flat. Curly hair curls a LOT in humid weather; hence, the frizz which we deal with! Anyway, I saw these and thought that maybe during those really dry winter days these would assist me in getting my hair to curl as it should. Now, the problem is, curly hair "fights" with some hair items - from my younger years my sisters used bristle curlers (they had straight hair) but the first time I tried using them, my hair like BIT INTO those bristles and man, I nearly had to cut my hair off to get those demon curlers out of my hair! These are similar, apparently to the bristle, demon curlers as they grabbed a hold of my wet hair and when I tried to pull one off, even holding onto the hair at my scalp, I could feel the tube holding onto my hair for dear life. That was with WET hair...I'm glad I did not wait for my hair to dry before attempting to pull the tube off! I have several friends with longer, straight hair and I'm sure they will have a different, happier and more comfortable experience than I did. What I'm saying is that I'm sure they work - for those with straight hair. If you have curly hair, best be careful when using them!

title: Works well for what I need
text: Yeah, I have a physical job that requires I wear a mask while working. I work in an non-air-conditioned warehouse so I sweat...having a headband that can catch some of the sweat trying to drip into my eyes helps, but now with having to wear the mask, having the buttons on the headband allows me to combine the two instead of having to try to hook the mask's elastic behind my ears and then pull the headband over my ears and getting it situated on my forehead. Life has changed and finding the best way to work with the new normal is the only way to go...and this headband is working for me - maybe it will work to make it easier for others!

title: I don't have "broken" hair
text: But I have baby-fine hair that is also curly. I always have hair around the hairline that will NOT lay flat or blend into the rest of my hair whether it is pulled back or down. Oh, and don't even get me started on humid/rainy days. Curly hair, especially baby-fine curly hair, frizzes like crazy in humidity. So yeah, I could spray the crap out of my hair with hairspray and have one great helmet head with not a hair out of place, but I absolutely hate hairspray. Besides, that would require washing my hair every time I coat it with hairspray - the problem is baby-fine, dry hair isn't made to be washed daily. So...I have lived with all those crazy "free-wheeling" hairs until trying this product. It worked so well I was amazed and it did not leave my hair feeling like a hair helmet! I used the mascara-like wand around the hairline from one ear to the other and those little hairs stayed in place! Cool beans! I will buy this again, definitely.

title: I decided not to cut my hair this summer
text: Usually I get a "summer cut" so that my hair doesn't make me any hotter during the summer months, but with the pandemic and all the salons closed, my hair is going to stay long over the hot summer months. I can do many things with it and one is to keep it away from my face with these headbands. I like the colors and the headbands themselves hold firmly in place which is just what I wanted. I have some that had a twist in them and for some reason, they don't hold in place on my head very well like these do. Colorful, comfortable to wear, and keeps my hair back - that's all I can ask for!

title: This is an all-inclusive package for those wanting to get into gel nail polish
text: I mean, you aren't starting with tons of colors or anything, but when you are new to gel nail polish, keeping it simple is the best way to begin the process. The two colors are nice, but I am sure once a person starts gel polish, they will love it and buy a set of colors that suit them. Now, the only thing I would change about this set is the UV light as it is very small. I already had a larger one and am comfortable using my big one as I can fit all four fingers under it with ease. Not that I have fat fingers or anything, but I just feel the included UV light is a tad smaller than most women would like. Other than that, this kit will get absolutely anyone started properly in the gel nail polishing procedure.

title: I've been using this a few days
text: And it is working to soften up my feet. As a kid I used to walk around barefoot outside all the time. Asphalt in summer does things to your feet...so over the years I've had problems with calluses built up over time. I put this on my feet and went to bed the first night. Put it on again in the morning and have been doing that regularly over the past few days. It does soften the hard, dry skin on my feet. The scent is a bit funky - eucalyptus and menthol are not my favorites, but considering it is my feet...I can handle that. Good cream for feet!

title: Love all the colors
text: I have very, very fine but very curly hair and am always trying to tame some little wisp of hair that refuses to stay in one place. These clips are about the only type of clips that work well in keeping my wispy hair in place for any length of time. The only thing that was a problem with these is that the side of the plastic these came in had torn and they were all over the shipping box. I mean aaalllll ooovvvveeerrr inside the shipping box. What a pain to pick all of these up...but I believe I got them all. I do love these little clips and love all the bright colors that I can use for spring and summer.

title: I bought this and another set for my niece to put on me
text: My niece is a professional and this is my way of getting professional work done without paying what she makes at her shop! Of course, she does stuff like this for me and her mom (my sister) every once in a while when we ask! So I got this and another tray for her to put on me and this tray was not really appropriate for my eyelashes - they were just a bit too thin to use on me. The other tray worked much better so next time I will not get this set. I'm hoping she can use it on another client of hers...might work for others, just not for me.

title: Followed the instructions above and got great results
text: I think part of it is choosing a good black under polish prior to adding the mirror powder as it needs that dark base to really shine and look like chrome. I chose the dark blue to try first and it looked stunning when done! The part I hate with gels is getting them off, but I'll work on getting better at that. I love the tangerine chrome powder and will be trying that next! These are gorgeous colors and I will be trying each of them in turn.

title: I haven't worn the pearl-covered ones
text: But I have worn all the rest! I love how these look on my head and they do a great job of keeping my hair back from my face when I'm working around the house. I mean, I've used scrunchies to pull my hair up on my head, but after a little while that hurts my scalp. These are gentle on both my hair and my scalp and they do look good (at least to me) on my head!

title: It does work...maybe not as well as they would like you to believe
text: Trying to get this right is the problem - it's an issue that can't be glossed over. If you can do it right, it looks nice, but the chances are, you will move along your eyebrow with this "pencil" and it will look goofy. I don't mean that you shouldn't try if that's what you want, but I'd rather just have a regular eyebrow pencil. That is easier to use and generally produces decent results for me.

title: These are nice for keeping hair back and look good doing it
text: I like having longer hair, but unless I braid it every time I want to do some work (or pin it up), it gets in my way. I mean, if I'm trying to move a chair from one room to another and when I lean down to grab the chair, I also get a handful of my own hair which also covers my face blocking my sight. Like my hair, hate that it gets in my way. I have a few different things - scrunchies is one, but sometimes I don't want to wear them...so, I got these headbands for an alternative and they work great! They keep my hair back just enough so I can work without it getting in my way. These twist headbands also look pretty while holding my hair back. Worth a try if you also have hair that sometimes gets in the way!

title: Sweet Orange is amazing!
text: Liquid body washes are my favorites, but some seem to dry my already dry skin out so that right after my shower, I have to slather on lotion to keep my skin from feeling tight and dry. Not so with this one! First, it smells so good - love the orange scent that envelopes the shower! Second, a small dollop on my scrubby lathers up well and cleans thoroughly without having to add any more to the scrubby (like other body washes). Last, when I step out to dry off, my skin feels hydrated and soft. I really like this body wash!

title: Not just for little girls!
text: I have very, very fine hair - meaning that each strand of my hair is exceptionally thin/fine. I have a LOT of hair, but because my hair is so fine, I have trouble with wispy strands coming loose at the wrong places. These type of clip work really well to keep my wispies corralled. Granted, these are very brightly colored, but I have a few of the kind that blend into my hair. What I was looking for was something that coordinated with what I was wearing so that I could "celebrate" my hair with the bright colors of these clips. I mean, why hide "difficult" hair issues? Or maybe hiding it in plain sight when wearing a Christmas-y red dress with red hair clips! If you have wispies that escape and make your up-do look messy, maybe you too could try bright clips to celebrate your wild and crazy hair!

title: Straight razor with a "guard"
text: That's basically what this is. First off, the box is written in Chinese, I believe, with absolutely no English on it. No instructions other than a pair of pictures. Not great pictures either. Not to be deterred, I opened the box, pulled one of the razors from the box, removed the plastic cover and tried it. If you look closely at the one picture, you will see what appears to be a drop of blood - it is. That is why I described this as a straight razor with a guard in quotes. Make NO mistake, these are SHARP. Use them delicately and only on smooth skin. If you have a blemish, a mole or anything just slightly raised on your skin, it will be cut off. You will bleed. Just want others to be aware of what this is and to take care not to hurt themselves.

title: Great quality
text: Absolutely beautiful craftsmanship, easy to grip with hands, and I love the fact that this is bigger than commercial toothbrushes feels nice !

title: very gentle and soothing
text: We use this for those between shower clean ups. It is easy to use and very gentle and soothing. Has not caused any issues. Can really be used anywhere as it is plenty gentle enough. Does a good job of getting rid of sweaty stink and leaves you feeling just showered fresh. This would be great for travel as well as home use.

title: something different
text: These bits work well and are compatible with all the nail drills I tried. The bits are good quality and seem like they should last a long time as long as you don't abuse them. The set has some unusual bit profiles that we found very useful, especially for tighter spots or smaller nails. The case keeps everything safe, in one place, and secure.

title: great set
text: This is a great nail set. It has all the bits you need to get started. It is well made and spins at a high RPM (12000?) Easy to swap out bits and the wand is easy to handle and great for fine detailed work. I only use it on top speed but it does have 3 seed total and can be reversed if needed. The battery holds a charge well and is enough to do a pair of hands. Recharge takes about an hour.

title: Working so far
text: We tried this out and so far it is working. We have a noticeable reduction in the amount of hair in the tested areas. It does take several weeks and several sessions to notice a difference. Plan on at least a half hour per session (depending on how large of an area you are doing. Make sure to wash after and use some skin lotion. text:
Saw this puppy discussed a lot on various shaving sites. They all said that you have to watch the YouTube videos to get the right technique for lathering. I watched a couple and have been trying this now for the past several weeks. I must have tried close to 40 different soaps, creams and sticks from the most expensive to the not so expensive. This one is right up there in terms of face glide and lubrication.Certainly in the top quintile. Why 4 stars? I have tried every variation to get a lather but there is no getting around that this is the most difficult soap I have ever tried. Too much water, too little water it seemed impossible to get it right the first time. No matter what I tried it seemed to either be too foamy and thin or not enough water to generate a lather. It's as if the gremlin in the soap puck was contrary enough to defeat whatever I tried until the 2nd or 3rd try.
Bottom lime- With effort and persistence it gets the job done and the fragrance is mildly pleasant but it will never be my "go-to" product. I'll stick with may favs: Kiss My Face, Cella and Proraso cream.
UPDATE:
Gave it another try with a little more patience. It seems that the end product you want is a little on the thick creamy side and not really a "lather". If you wet your brush, turn it over and let all the water drip out that you can,then you apply brush to soap and be patient and determined you will get the thick rich cream that will do the trick. One other tip I found after you apply the cream to the face let it sit for about 20-30 seconds before you apply your razor. You will then get the greatest glide you will experience. Accordingly I have moved it up the top tier and displaced the Proraso cream.I would give it 4 1/2 stars, and not 5, if I could because of the difficult lathering.
FURTHER UPDATE
After using this puppy for a little while I have come to master it and love it. Great for glide and closeness and absence of irritation. I originally rated it a 4 but now after careful consideration I must admit that it deserves a 5 star rating. Its among my top 3 favorite shaving products.

Comfortable to use, it does not squeeze the head. But it holds all the hair back.

I love the bow! Very 50’s!!!
Great colors. Like it a lot.

title: Not exactly holy grail...
text: The concept behind this set of masks is pretty cool, and the names are cute. The masks themselves, however, aren't anything to write home about. They smell fresh in a more herbal kind of way, and the textures are a mix between creamy and gel-like. The big issue I have is the container design. The bowls come with a good sized amount because a little goes a long way, but there's no way to seal them back up for later use. I had to put them in ziplock bags.

title: This stuff is awful!
text: I couldn't use this but one time! It broke me out, dried me out, irritated my skin, and the rose scent is overwhelming. The texture is fairly decent as far as cleansing balms go, but it's a very aggressive cleanser and not in a good way. My skin felt rough and raw when I was done using it. I've used Clean It Zero for a while and highly recommend it over this balm. Steer clear!

title: Great size, nice and bright!
text: This is a really nice lighted, mirrored compact! So many times, the lights aren't bright enough to do you much good, there's only a single regular mirror, and/or the size is just too small to give you a proper look. Not so with this compact. You get two mirrors for the price of one, a regular mirror and one with a higher magnification for those times when you need a closer inspection. The light has a lovely, and very helpful, color temperature that's pretty close to daylight, just a bit warmer, and is featured around both mirrors. It's operated by a switch on the bottom, so you aren't wasting your batteries. It runs off of two coin batteries. The mirror is larger than most. I have larger than average hands for a woman, and this compact is bigger than my palm. It's a great size for quick once overs and more detailed makeup application. I even prefer using it over my bathroom mirror for doing my eyebrows.

title: Smells great and keeps my hands soft...
text: After falling in love with the C.O. Bigelow Rose Salve, I knew I had to give this a try. I haven't been disappointed with the results. Not only does it have a sweet, citrusy smell, it also moisturizes and softens my dry, chapped skin. I deal with dry hands in the winter and I'm a big hand washer, so I end up with rough, cracked skin. This light yellow, creamy hand lotion has helped to keep my hands from feeling like sandpaper without leaving them greasy.

title: Cute but the cap is too small...
text: I thought this would be a fun wig to wear to bed, if you get my drift. It's cute and the colors are blended together nicely, with small streak of lavender mixed into the blue. The "scalp" looks great and is a nice nude color. It mimics a Caucasian scalp really well, which is great for a pale gal like me. The cut is sweet and it's styled well. The bangs need trimming up but that shouldn't be a problem. The tresses feel like all synthetic wigs do. They are wavy but still have that plastic feel to them. The big issue for me is the size of the wig cap itself. I have black hair and the wig "scalp" is so short that several inches of the top of my natural hair shows through it. It does come with a hair cap but oddly, it's black and not nude, which would be the smarter choice. I have a nude hair cap that I'll be trying with it, but I'm not expecting much difference. The wig is just too small in general.

title: This little bugger works!
text: I'll be honest. I was rather skeptical when I received this. It looks sleek and pretty but does it actually work? My answer to that question is a resounding YES. You wouldn't think a little buzzing device could make your skincare products do their best job but boy, oh, boy does it ever. The three settings are for Cleansing (also used for extractions), Moisturizing, and Lifting. Each setting causes the device to vibrate at different speeds and achieve different goals. Using it is fairly easy. Hold the button until you hear it turn on and then give the button a quick press to choose between functions. There are lights above each mode and they will light up when you are on said mode. The included instructions are very easy to follow and explain how to use it in a simple way. It's all about keeping very light pressure, while holding the side bars, which add the effective charge to the device, allowing the ionization process to take place. I have seen a difference in my skin already and I have only used it in each mode 3-4 times. It could be easy to overdo it after seeing the results you do, but the instructions specifically advice you on how often each function should be used so the skin isn't having reverse effects from what you want it to. I think the price for this item is fantastic! I have a reduction in blackheads, my skin seems to glow after use, and my products are sinking into my skin better and faster. This one for the win!

title: Cool once you get the hang of it....but the price...
text: I'm someone with extremely thick and stick straight hair. My hair loses curl within an hour of me fixing it. I've tried other rotating curling irons and haven't had much success with them, so I didn't have very high expectations for this beach waver. I have been pleasantly surprised. Once I got the hang of it, I found it to be pretty easy to use. It features buttons that allow you to chooses which direction you would like to curl each section of hair, and a Home button that after each use, and after the previous section of hair is no longer attached, allows the barrel to return to a neutral starting point. I ran into an issue the first few times I used it, which was accidentally hitting the home button while my hair was still around the barrel. This caused the hair to get very tight and the barrel to press up against the scalp. This is very easy to do and I definitely think a design change should take place to correct this issue. The barrel is long enough for my medium-long hair and I can see it needing to be used more than once up and down the length of long hair. The curling iron gets up to 410 degrees max, which works pretty well on my thick hair. I've tried fixing my hair in different ways after using it, to see which method holds the curls longer. I still have an issue with my hair losing the curls a bit to quickly but it's remedied by using styling products before and after curling it. To be honest, I think this beach waver is very overpriced. Maybe the results would be better for someone with thinner hair but I don't think I'd pay more than $50 for this curling iron. Nice results, but the design flaws make this a product I won't reach for that often.

title: I'm not sure this is worth the price asked...
text: I've always wanted to get into the art of doing my own acrylics so when I saw this drill set, I knew I had to review it. Firstly, it comes with numerous accessories- a fluffy brush for removing dust from the nail and work area, a set of to separaters for painting, a nail board, and the drill bits themselves. The entire set is nicely packaged and comes nestled in a velvety foam materials. The bits are held in their own clear container within the box. The set comes with a detachable adapter that plugs into the end of the drill and then into the wall outlet. The drill itself is small enough to handle pretty easily, although I can see where it would be difficult for someone with smaller hands than myself (I have large hands.) Inserting and removing the bits can be a challenge. The mechanism isn't well made so I have to fight with it. The power cord is much too short and I had to use an extension cord to give myself some wiggle room away from the wall outlet. Some of the bits' textures do a better job than the others, while some don't do anything at all. The over all look and feel of the set isn't worth the price, in my opinion. It works a bit too awkwardly to be something I'd use that often.

title: Great lamp!
text: I really enjoy this UV lamp. It's sleek design and concept make it easy to use. I like the buttons designated for each separate drying time and the LED display is easy to read and understand. It works like a champ and does a great job! I truly think this lamp is worth the price, and I think you'll like it as much as I do.

title: You can't beat this price!
text: These are great cotton rounds! I used to get the CVS 360 brand but they were getting expensive because I used a few each day. Luckily, I found this huge pack of awesome rounds. They are super soft but not so soft that they don't hold up when wet. They are fantastic when you don't want to waste product because they absorb just the right amount and actually extend the life of my products. The price is low and the amount of cotton rounds in this big pack can't be beat!

title: Meh product...
text: These are good for those late nights when you’re too exhausted to do your whole routine, although I HIGHLY recommend doing a quick double cleansing regardless. They seem to remove dirt but don’t work well for removing oil-based makeup. Make sure to understand that this has to be rinsed off, or you’re falling asleep with soap on your face. I won’t be repurchasing.

title: Worth a try!
text: This kit is a great deal! I've been a devoted user of Korean skin care products. For a while, I have preferred, out of several brands and types of sheet mask, the Benton Bee and Snail sheet mask. Fantastic product!!!! Firms, smooths, soothes. It's great. However, that's not why I purchased this set. I have combo skin that leans towards oily in the heat. Super oily T-zone. After doing a ton of research, I decided to give the Benton Aloe Gel moisturizer a try. I'd also heard great things about this foam cleanser. I'm really enjoying the cleanser so far. I wet my hands and face, use only a pea sized amount, rub my hands together to create the foam (not a soapy lather, but a thick and creamy foam), and work over my face. I do this after oil cleansing. This does a great job of picking up any oil residue and dirt, while leaving my face soft and refreshed. Never tight and dry, which is the sign of an awful cleanser. The gel moisturizer is okay. Just okay. I don't get as oily as I did with lotion moisturizers, which is great. However, I don't have that supple, smooth feel that I'm used to and prefer. I've actually noticed flaking around my nose, which is something I never dealt with after moisturizing. A pea sized amount covers my entire face, it leaves a slightly tacky finish until absorbed ( I always let each of my products absorb for around 90 seconds before applying the next step), and is completely colorless. Will I repurchase? No, but I do suggest that you give this a try if your research and needs point you this direction. Everyone's skin care needs can vary on several levels. There are universal musts for good skin health, like cleansing daily, moisturizing, and using a good sunscreen. There a a ton a variations of those products, though. Finding the right routine and products can be a trial and error process. The main thing is to stick to it. The results are worth it!

title: Exactly as promised! Love it!
text: This is a very nice magnifying mirror, in a beautiful oil rubbed bronze finish! Especially for the price point! There were very similar items for twice as much, but I'm so glad I chose to purchase this one for our bathroom. My husband is starting to get more gray in his beard than not, and has been having trouble seeing it all while shaving. I got this for him (and for myself, but don't tell him) and he has been thrilled with it. The three lighting choices are gorgeous and very useful, as is the 10x magnification side of the swivel mirror head. I'm thinking of getting one for my mom and sister, as well. Great buy!

title: Very clean wig and beautiful coloring!

The wig goes down a little past my chest area. It may feel a a bit heavy, but is not too bad to wear for long periods of time for an event.

title: Wonderful color that highlights the eye!
text: This product goes well with lightening up your eye. I found it is helpful to make my Asian eyes a bit bigger! I love the cute pink color and it makes your makeup much more attractive and more attention! Less is more is a helpful tip as the product can go on a bit much.

title: For 6 to 10 year old kids
text: The clips are larger then I expected. The colors are nice. The quality seems to be good. Overall it is a nice set.

title: Nice gift. Perfect for travel.
text: Ready to use straight out of the box. The color is pretty retro but it works. You will notice that it doesn't come with an outlet connection just a USB cable. You get a total of 6 brush head so you don't need to worry about replacements for a while. The brush heads aren't my favorite but they aren't bad. There is a control for the strength of the vibration which I love! It also gives notification after every 30 seconds, which is really great. Over all I am really happy.

title: Wonderful essential oil diffuser!
text: It does everything it says it will. I like the simple style it has, and it is very easy to use.

title: Good Value
text:
If you want an inexpensive skin treatment for your skin to moisturize and keep it fresh and young-looking, this product has some good ingredients. It says safe for dry and sensitive skin. I have combination skin, and it works fine for me.

Ingredients include: 100% Vegan Hyaluronic Acid - professional hydrating serum,enriched with anti-aging Vitamins C+E and Green tea. Also included is Jojoba Oil, Retinol and Aloe.

It fills in fine lines and plumps your skin, reduces age spots, brightens skin etc.

It is paraben-free, cruelty-free, hypoallergenic, vegan, and is a serum.

The price at $5 an ounce seems to be about 1/3 of other similar serums.

I use a rotation of products on my skin as each product has strengths and does what others don't. This seems to exfoliate a bit, and moisturize. My skin looked good the morning after I used it. You can put it on under foundation the company says.

It has about a 3-year shelf life. You will probably use it up in the first month or two.

title: Firms Up the Under Eye Area
text:
This goes on easily - has a metal rounded surface which emits watery liquid slowly.

It does firm up the skin around the eye as it dries.

I guess it would be great to put on before a party if your eyes are puffy. And at night to reduce puffiness in the morning.

Right now I like this product. After using it for a longer time, I might love this product.

It didn't hurt my eyes, sting, or get into my eyes as some eye products have done in the past. The ingredients appear healthy.

The product kind of rolls on like roll-on deoderant used to do. So, it's not messy.

title: Tastes Good
text:
This is NOT to put on your skin.

This is to drink.

My husband and I tasted it and liked the flavor. It is a yummy orange. The expiration date is January, 2019. So, you don't have to drink it right away. You DO need to refrigerate it. And use it within a month of opening it. You take one tablespoon a day, and follow with 8 oz. water.

This is fairly expensive. At $79 - about $2.50 which is an inexpensive meal.

title: So Far So Good
text: Like the container and the pump action. Product feels pleasant with a light scent. Not wild about the scent, but if this works, it's okay. It goes on easily. So far, I like the product. After using it a month, will decide if I love it as for what it does for my skin. Like the natural ingredients in the product.

Eyebrow Stamp Stencil Kit, Double EyeBrow
Stamp Kit, Perfect Eyebrow Powder Stamp
Makeup with with 24 Reusable Eyebrow

title: diminishing breakouts
text:
Not Or Omega 7 Sea Buckthorn Oil Soft Gels,
Anytime Face Wash, Facial Defense Oil, Skin
Cleansing, Skin Moisturizing Core Kit

This facial cleansing wash, with sea buckthorn oil soft gels, and the facial defense oil, seem to
work really well together. My wife and daughter both get small bouts of acne during the month
and they’ve both benefited from this kit in diminishing breakouts and gently keeping their skin
clean and moisturized. They both want to continue using it and see if the soft gels make a
difference, but until then they are very happy with this kit. Four stars

title: Good during the winter months when skin is dryer
text:
[The Skin House] Wrinkle Snail System
Cream (1.69 fl.oz / 50ml) Firming, blemish,
repair, anti-aging

It took my wife a while to try this cream since it was made with snail mucin and to her, that
sounded less than appealing. However, once she did try it, she liked it. She said that it left her
skin softer and well hydrated. It doesn’t have a bad smell, which she was concerned about, and
the consistency was smooth and not sticky. She has combination skin, so this cream will be
good during the winter months when her skin is dryer. However, she said she will use a lighter
cream for the warmer months. Four stars

title: Wife really loves it
text:
Facial Steamer Nano Hot Steam Face Spa
Device Ionic Face Steaming Machine for
Home Facials Personal Moisturizing
Humidifier Vaporizer for Skincare Beauty

when I saw this one, I thought it was a good deal. So far, she really likes it. She says that the
water heats up quickly and the steam coming out is smooth and doesn’t spit out any water. The
little cool mist steamer will come in handy on hot days, which will be coming up soon here in
California. Even though this comes with some acne removing tools, my wife has not used those
so cannot comment on whether they are effective or not. The steamer and mister, however, has
been something she really loves. Five stars

title: says water proof but has an open usb port
text:
Facial Cleansing Brush, Sonic Ultrasonic
Vibration Facial Brush, Red-light for Deep
Cleaning, Discharge Makeup, Gentle
Exfoliating, Blackhead Removing, Massaging
with 3 Adjustable Modes and Speeds

My wife has used many facial cleansing tools in the past, but wanted something with a little
more portability. After reading more about this brush, she liked the features it mentioned and
decided to try it. It arrived well packaged, and undamaged. It came with instructions and a usb
cord. After trying it for a while, my wife said she really likes the shape and the way it feels in her
hand. It is easy to maneuver around the contours of her face and she feels her face is getting
cleaner after using it. Although she likes the red light feature, it is not something she uses
regularly. She does like that it is small enough to carry in her purse. However, one of the main
reasons she wanted this is because of the waterproof capability. But with the usb port open, she
really does not feel comfortable using it in the shower. That was a disappointment. Also, it
does not come with a carrying case or bag, which would have been nice. I am giving it four
stars because the features we are left with are good ones and my wife feels that her skin has
improved since using this brush.

title: Not effective enough as some other skincare products
text:
MD Complete Bright & Healthy Citrus-C Refresh Retinol + Vitamin C Multitasking Treatment

My wife got this multitasking treatment of vitamin C and retinol, to combat uneven skin texture and fine lines. She used it for a while and afterward said that at least for her skin, she didn’t notice that much of a difference. There was some brightening, but not effective enough as some other skincare products that she’s tried. Overall, it may be good with those with minor skin issues, or maintaining good skin, but not if there’s a skin issue that is trying to be reversed.

title: Plumps and smooths skin
text:
Hylunia Facial Day Lotion - 1.7 fl oz - Anti-Aging for Wrinkles - with Shea Butter, Hyaluronic Acid Serum, Zinc - Natural Vegan Moisturizer - Rapid Skin Repair

My wife has recently started using Hylunia skin care products. So when she saw their Day Lotion, she thought she would give it a try. She is very happy with the results of this product. She said it plumps and smooths her skin and absorbs really well. It goes on well under her makeup and does not cause her foundation to streak. Even though it is a little pricey at around $67.00, it is definitely a product worth paying for.

title: contains clean ingredients

NATURAL Moisturizing Facial Masks (ALOE VERA 4PK Box) | Deep Moisturizer Face Sheet Masks for Dry, Sensitive and Tired Skin

My wife really liked this moisturizing face mask with aloe. She suffers from allergies, so her skin is dry and sensitive during those times. This face mask contains clean ingredients, and is perfect to get someone with allergies and sensitive through harsher weather months.

text: I use this to wash my poodle and I love it!!

title: Works fine
text: This is a nice little nail lamp, works just as it should, well made and it's pretty. Comes with some nice extra gifts as well. 5 stars!

I have only used it with regular nail polish so far, but my daughter has some gel polish I will try next. If anything changes I will update my review. text: Nice nail kit, very thorough on the selection of accessories. Works great.

title: Keeps puppy and dog fly-away hairs firmly in their bands
text:
This stuff is amazing! I didn't even know such a product existed and was excited to try it when I found it. My baby shih tzu has a top knot that's in the awkward stage where most will stay in a band or clip but the lower pieces fall down into her eyes.

I applied a bit of this and all the hair is staying put, LOVE THIS SO MICH! This tub will probably last me awhile but when it's gone I will be back to buy more.

title: Best clips for long, fine hair!
text:
My hair is long and very fine/slippery, so I generally find that jaw clips are too small to hold all of my hair, too large/weak to keep my hair from slipping loose, and/or too heavy and fall off off my head under its own weight. These clips address all issues fabulously: the long but narrow shape captures all of my hair but clamps it closely enough that the strands don’t slip free and the lightweight nature means that gravity won't pull the clip loose. I can use these clips for both a full bun (I do need to double my long hair over to fit in the clip) or a half-up style.

I do object to calling the shade of these “wine red” when the product picture is plainly some kind of magenta shade. The actual clips are darker and mauvier than pictured and certainly pretty, but a far cry from “wine red” still.

title: Great dispenser, but overpriced product
text:
I don't find the dry shampoo powder itself to be much better than plain cornstarch or arrowroot flour, especially as a product for blondes. But, the squeeze top dispenser is excellent. I would not repurchase this, but plan to reuse the container for DIY powder dry shampoo.

Speaking as someone with black hair who did not realize this product was for blondes when ordering, this product had more of a white cast than most dry shampoos but it wasn't a huge issue---it largely blended away once worked in thoroughly as per usual. Last I checked, the version for brunettes was more expensive, which seems ridiculous.

title: Beautiful finish and wear time
text:
This is a beautiful foundation. I tried applying this both with a flocked powder puff and a foundation brush. I did prefer the powder puff, which did a better job of picking up the powder through the elasticated net dispenser. The finish is what I would call a "luminous matte" or "lit from within"---it definitely wasn't flat but didn't look dewy or greasy, either. It applied very smoothly over some very textured spots on my skin and covered blemishes well.

Unfortunately, the shade range sucks. I typically need a shade described as "very fair", which are harder to find in mineral foundations. The 100 Light shade is too dark for me unless I also cover my whole neck and chest with it, but the finish is beautiful and I honestly would wear it out on days I'm wear a scarf, for example. I would describe this shade as fair-light or light with a neutral peach undertone.

If you are familiar with the Tarte loose powder foundation, this seems very similar but without the clay that tends to oxidize. They have the same style of packaging (elasticated net + stopper lid), same luminous matte finish, and similar longevity.

title: Excellent for travel and regular use
text:
These are very sturdy bottles with a smooth pump mechanism. I saw no leaking when I used these to fly with shampoo and conditioner recently.

Each pump is fairly small and consistent, which makes it very easy to regulate the amount used. I think I will be using these regularly and not just for travel for items without a pump or where the pumps are very inconsistent, like body lotion.

title: Lovely talc-free blushes
text: Such as beautiful shade! I really like that the Cheek Pop formula can be applied very sheerly, which means that I, as a very pale person, can wear deeper blush shades like Cola Pop. I still need to be very careful to use a light hand with application, though. Also, the Cheek Pop formula is talc-free!

title: Makeup pads!
text: Great deal for the price. Not that easy to clean. But for the price I will order more and toss these out.

title: Irritates my skin...
text: These aren't pads to clean make-up off your face(at least not fully), like I thought they were. They're actually supposed to be used after washing your face. After wiping your face with them, you're supposed to press any excess liquid onto your skin and then leave it. I found them a little too harsh for my skin. On the front of the container, it says they're soothing, but I didn't get that at all. My face feels scratched and irritated after I use them and I for sure don't like the feeling of leaving the liquid on my face. It's an itchy feeling and it makes me anxious, as opposed to soothed. I ended up having to wash it off after each time I gave them a try. I like the idea of them, but unfortunately, they're not for me.

title: Quieter than regular clippers, but best for thinner hair....
text:
My children don't like haircuts, but my 6 year old has an especially hard time with it. While these seem mostly targeted to babies, I decided to give them a try for my older children. These clippers helped the process and all of my children preferred them. That said, these do work better on thinner hair. My two older children have thick hair and these clippers struggled with it. I ended up using another pair of clippers to thin their hair out a bit before swapping back to these. I didn't mention trying new clippers or explain the swapping back and forth, but they still requested I go back to these. These clippers do still make noise when in use, but it is more muted than regular clippers.

Overall, I'd say these are great to use on thinner/finer hair, but for thicker hair, just be prepared to thin it out first. Other than that, I've been super pleased with them.

title: Hard to wash out....
text: This cream works pretty well and it doesn't take much. It kept my hair from being frizzy and it defined my curls. That said, maybe my hair is too fine for it. It left an odd feeling to my hair(like a layer of residue) and it's super hard to wash out. I like to wash all products out of my hair before going to bed and I didn't like that my hair still felt dirty after washing(even using my best shampoo). Overall, it's not for me. It may be better for thicker hair, though.

title: Does its job...
text: The case of this kit looks on the cheap side. It's almost like stained silver. That said, the tools inside work well. They're not my favorite, by any means, but they do the job. It is a nice travel sized kit, so it would work well for small spaces, too. There are quite a few items inside, so it's a little annoying trying to get certain items out. I didn't know what a good bit of them were for, but it still has a place for everything, all within a small-ish, flat case. It has everything I need for my nails(plus more) and doesn't take up much space, so I have to appreciate it for that.

title: Smells Nice

And the other one is now stuck with a 3 star review average just because of that mix-up.

At first I was nervous that even with the exfoliation back (this one), it would not be as good as it was before when it had the exfoliation originally, because it used to be oatmeal for the exfoliation, and now it is coffee grounds. I even sent them a note asking why they didn't use oatmeal any more, and they said it was because the oatmeal version would fall apart in the Amazon warehouses. But I tried the coffee ground exfoliation - and even though it isn't quite as good - it's still great. This soap beats any other I've tried to purchase, and I have purchased about 10 brands through Amazon that all said they were exfoliating. Only one of them was exfoliating enough, and I like this one better. (I forget the name of that other brand right now; I'm at my computer. If someone really wants to know, add a comment and I'll dig it up.) I really need a very strong exfoliating soap, and this one actually is strong enough. It also happens to be a brown bar with a decent hearty soap material, as well - not phony - so it is all I need.

Just wanted to post this review to start to bring back some 5 stars for this company now that they've gotten things sorted out and have two varieties, one exfoliating and one that isn't.

title: The best.
text:
After having used this product for a month, I find myself hooked. As YMMV when taking someone's word on shave gear, I thought I might provide some background about me: I have gentle to oily skin and stiff, tough neck hairs. I used to think I had sensitive skin until I married someone with actual sensitive skin. But the combination of the tough hairs and the gentleness of my skin leads to irritation on the neck when I am not careful. I learned to shave with a gillette adjustable years ago(which I still use), but out of "convenience" (really, a lack of good shaving products and knowhow) I stopped using it for cartridge systems in my early twenties. Since I started shaving right, some time ago, I got an EJ-89 which I use when I'm feeling raw, and an old type open comb gillette (which, for the moment at least, I favor for its closeness- I use personna lab blue blades or sharper in it). I've tried a number of different soaps and a few creams, most of which are good. Mitchell's is excellent. It has a simple, clean smell like fresh linen and is the most thoroughly hydrating shaving product I have ever used. It lathers up easily- I've used my beat up old drugstore boar brush which is now probly 15 years old and a silvertip badger brush.. In either case, the lather whips up in a minute or less with no complications. I'm not one of these people that soaks the puck either, I just heat it up in its dish, in a basin of hot water as I soak my brush and it is good to go. I've heard that water hardness and temp can make a difference with this stuff, but as I have decidedly soft water here in the city, I can't really comment on that. But once you get the lather right, with enough water, it is eaaasy on the face. Amazing even.. I dreamt wetshaving was like this as a teenager..
One might be put off by the price which may seem hefty for a newcomer to the wetshaving game, eager to start saving money (previously lost on walking the cartridge treadmill) and reticent to buy apparently expensive luxury shaving soaps, but aside from being a quality product, It lasts for a quite a while. I was really going to wait until I had exhausted mine to write this review but it's been a month, and the puck looks basically the same size! Growing up on Williams soap and favoring Van der Hagen as a drugstore standby these days, I notice one soap generally lasts me a month (some less than that), but aside from the simply larger size of Mitchells (4.4 oz to 2.5 oz for standard mug size soaps), you just get more bang for your buck. I'm guessing this one will last me three months or more.. So at that rate, the price basically factors out altogether.
To sum up, if you have gentle or easily irritated skin and aren't looking for a heavily scented product, this is the grail of soaps for you. One word: I wouldn't spring for the dish because I am cheap. You might not be.. But the soap itself does perfectly fit a rice bowl or large ramekin, in case you were wondering.. Probably not a mug though, unless it were seriously oversized..

title: Works much better than acetone, but watch your surfaces!
text:
Do you see “100% Natural” and think “Yeah, right!” or do you assume it won’t work as well as products that have chemicals? I do this all the time especially when it comes to cleaning products or makeup. In this case I was offered a bottle of Pure Body Naturals™ 100% Natural Nail Polish Remover and the skeptical part of me was sure this wouldn’t turn out well. But in the spirit of trying new things, I agreed to review it and put it to the test. **See the images for before/after photos**

For my test I painted my nails several different colors. We all know deep reds are harder to get off and glitters can also be a pain to remove. I dedicated my left hand to the Pure Body Naturals™ 100% Natural Nail Polish Remover and my right hand I used a drugstore brand of acetone polish remover (the super cheap stuff I usually use.) Both hands got two good coats of polish.

To remove the polish the Pure Body Naturals™ remover instructions say to drop or dab it on and wait 2-3 minutes before wiping. For the generic acetone remover I just apply and wipe with a cotton ball.

The Pure Body Naturals™ remover wiped right off, taking most of the polish with it. I did have to reapply a small amount, wait a few more minutes and all but one tiny trace of the red polish was gone. The acetone remover left polish near my cuticles even after a hard scrubbing and a second try.

So what did I like?
-I like that it works better than the acetone remover, even on the darkest red and glitter!
-I like that it did not make my nails feel dry.
-I like that the Pure Body Naturals™ remover doesn’t have harsh chemicals.
-I like that it isn’t tested on animals.
-I like that it comes with a handy glass dropper.

The only problem (and it could have been a BIG one) is this polish will eat through any polish, including vanish on my dining room table and styrofoam plates. No kidding. I started out thinking to drip the remover over a plate to keep it off the table but it quickly melted the styrofoam and one small spot of the table varnish.

Only use this stuff in the bathroom over tile or a sink with no finish/paint/lacquer, etc. never over a delicate surface like your dining room table!

I received a free sample of this remover to review. I have given my honest opinion and the real test/comparison results.

title: New Maybuy Beard Trimmer Takes On Viking Beard -- And Wins!
text:
The gene pool I come from has Viking, German, and Irish heritage -- resulting in a stiff wiry beard that defeats most cordless beard trimmers. To give this trimmer a good chance I followed the directions and charged it for the two hours as recommended in the instructions. My only gripe about this process is that you're supposed to keep an eye on it so that when charging is finished you can disconnect it immediately to avoid potential damage. Since the unit has no automatic shut-off when charging is completed, you have to keep an eye on it to avoid a problem. That is my only gripe about this unit. Not too many people have the time flexibility to watch it for the two hours (or less) it needs to charge.

While it only comes with 3 attachments that is all you really need. The shaver itself is large enough to give you a firm grip and the weight implies quality. The initial effort at trimming my beard was highly successful. I grew it for two weeks to make it a challenge and then shaved it without using any attachments. Normally (with other units) I would have expected difficulty in shaving it flush with my skin. Typically this type of trimmer is not powerful enough to plow through my beard, pulls some hair out instead of cutting it, and sometimes nicks my skin. None of that happened here. Evidently the battery and the motor are up to the task.

This is by far the best cordless trimmer I have ever owned and used. Highly recommended!

So, I decided to use this to help moisturize and twist my hair. I could just feel my hair going from super dry to extremely soft and moisturized from just one application of each section! I also applied this over castor oil, which I applied to my hair beforehand. (I use the L.O.C. moisturization method).

I then twisted my hair and applied this generously (my twist outs always come out better when I'm more generous with my product of choice). After 10 hours or so, I took out my twists and had a very well-defined twist out! There was absolutely no frizz - even after separating each twist (I undo the twist and the split each section in half). I'm really happy with the results.

The pics I'm included are of a two-day-old twist out (I forgot to take a pic on the first day) and my hair still looks great - a little frizzy from sleeping on it, but nothing horrible. I just spritzed on a little leave-in conditioner to refresh my hair and it looked just as good as the first day. This cream is wonderful and allows me to easily go 4-5 days on one twist out - something that many other products just don't do for my hair.

This has a really sweet, pleasant smell to it. It's a white cream that's on the thick side, but very easy to work with and absorbs nicely into the hair - doesn't just sit on top. I also love that it doesn't make my hair feel all crunchy or crispy. My twist out was really soft and my curls were bouncy. Thanks to providing great hold, amazing definition, and complete hydration for dry, frizzy hair, you can't get wrong using this product!

title: Roller Ball May Not Be the Best Mode of Application
text:
I've been using this serum for 5 days, AM and PM. I believe I see some minor reduction in the lines under my eyes...but it could be wishful thinking. I am not convinced there is always serum coming out while rolling it on because the nature of steel is that it feels cool to the touch, therefore can give the impression of depositing serum when, in fact, it isn't. To determine this I ran it over white tissue several times; only about 50% of the time did serum actually come out. I removed and cleaned the steel roller ball as directed then reran my "experiment" and had the same results.

During application I can briefly detect a damp look where it is being deposited, but this goes away within seconds. At other times nothing is on the surface of my face and immediate dabbing with a tissue proves there is no serum. I am not convinced this is the best mode of application.

If, after a couple of months of use, I see definite wrinkle reduction I will happily update my review accordingly.

title: Vibrant color, but very messy.
text:
I'm posting a pic of my hair pre-bleach, post bleach, and post pink dye. I probably didn't need to bleach it but the last time I tried to dye my hair with pinks (two different brands) it just didn't take very well.

This took very well. The kit includes all you need (I used different gloves just because I prefer others). The directions are simple and complete. I would say that if you have hair longer than chin, maybe shoulder length, you will need at least two boxes. I have a pixie cut and used about half of both the bleach and dye. I always follow the direction when bleaching and did follow their directions. I never follow directions when using these "Direct dye" bright colors. Instead of the 30-60 minutes, I left mine in for 5 hours. I got a very vibrant pink (a little more fuchsia than the pictures on the box).

My one complaint is that this definitely left me with more dye rubbing off than some other brands have. When I used other brands I might wake up the next morning to a streak light on my pillow and that was with lot of hair. Using this on short hair, my pillow looked like a pink paintball fight happened. This and all dyes like it will dye anything and everything they touch. So I highly recommend two things - 1. protect everything (your skin around your face and neck with Vaseline) 2. If possible do NOT rinse your hair in a shower/bathtub. If you have access to a stainless steel sink or some kind of utility / laundry room sink where stains won't matter, that is so much easier to clean.

The hair is very soft and doesn't irritate me like my synthetic wigs. However, I think they sent me the wrong length, but I'm not upset about it - for a human hair wig that's this versatile (read: can be worn by a white girl) this price is really great and I understand that on their end things might be hectic. I got a bad haircut a week ago and wasn't able to leave my house, was super depressed, crying all the time when i saw a mirror. This wig is a great solution as the semester is starting in one week and I absolutely have to be on campus. It's less hot than other wigs I have, and I feel confident that this looks natural enough to pass as I start meeting new people at my new school. One thing though is that the wig I received is NOT lace front. Since I gave it full bangs, that doesn't really matter, and I don't care that much about that in general because I will make sure to have bangs with any wig, but I thought it would be lace front and it would have been my first so I was disappointed it wasn't. If you're looking for only lace front, skip this one. But overall I'm giving it 5 stars because I really can't imagine the quality for the price being any better than this.

title: Two 5 STAR and Two 4 STAR Fragrances- some are sure to please every man
text:
English Laundry Men's 4 Piece 20ml Coffret is a truly wonderful men’s cologne set. You are getting four fragrances- rated 4 and 5 STARS all in one box. The fragrances rated by me are based on my years spent working in a cosmetic factory. I will list each fragrance separately.

ARROGANT- With top notes of bergamot and cedar you get a woodsy freshness to the scent. The middle notes of coriander and lavender bring a warm, clean freshness. At the base are sandalwood, amber and musk bringing a warm, sensual, spicy scent. All together, you get a spicy, warm, woodsy scent with a distinctive freshness to it. This light, sensual scent lasts all day and smells wonderful on almost every man, so 5 STARS.

OXFORD BLEU- The top notes of mint and lemon add a citrus freshness. The middle notes of iris and geranium bring a very light floral scent. The base adds sandalwood and vanilla for a woodsy delicious scent. All together, this scent is light, with an undertone bit of floral and clean citrus and a nice light woodsy smell. This light, woodsy fragrance smells fabulous on almost every man and does last long for 5 STARS.

RIVIERA- With top notes of lemon, bergamot, lime and cedar, you get a refreshing citrus/woods scent. In the middle are jasmine, patchouli, vetiver, lavender and mandarin- most of these were used in the 60's sexy, warm, earthy scents. At the base notes are nutmeg and coumarin to add some spice. This is not for every man, but for a man who likes a more vibrant scent. These scents are very noticeable and not light, being a very woodsy, earthy, warm fragrance with a touch of zest. 4 STARS.

NOTTING HILL- The top notes begin with bergamot, lemon and lime for a clean, natural scent. Then the middle notes have bolder peppercorn and jasmine bringing a rose/herbal scent. At the bottom are cedarwood, sandalwood, amber and a powdery musk for a very potent woodsy, animal musky scent. This is definitely not for every man being very heavy scents. There is nothing light about this fragrance. 4 STARS.

With four interesting fragrances, two being light and two being heavy, every man is sure to find one he will like. Lighter scents always smell wonderful on almost every man and the bolder scents smell great on a man depending on how his chemistry goes with the bolder fragrances. 4 ½ STARS.
